blocks.text: Sullivan Station Homes for Sale | Surrey BC MLS

parts.t: Sullivan Station is one of Surrey's family-oriented communities, offering a mix of modern detached homes, townhouses and newer developments. Known for its strong schools, parks and residential feel, Sullivan Station attracts buyers looking for space, value and long-term growth.

Browse the latest Sullivan Station MLS listings including newer construction homes, family properties and townhomes. Listings are updated regularly so you can view current prices, photos and full property details.
Thinking about buying or selling in Sullivan Station? Call or text Jared Gibbons at 604-928-1361.

blocks.text: Sullivan Station: Family Homes in Sullivan Heights

parts.t: Sullivan Station (Sullivan Heights) is a family-oriented Surrey neighbourhood of mostly detached homes and townhomes around 152 Street, 64 Avenue, and Highway 10. Buyers choose it for practical commuting within Surrey and the Fraser Valley, nearby schools and parks, and everyday shopping along the Sullivan Heights commercial strips.

Housing here skews toward ground-oriented family living. Streets are generally well maintained, with parks and school catchments that serve the area. If you are comparing Sullivan Station with nearby Cloverdale or Fleetwood, ask for a current listing shortlist and recent sales.
Can't find what you're looking for? Jared can search the full MLS® for you.
